scope: Miao Chapter 22 (pp. 773-801): limited commitment (dynamic programming in the promised value, the Lagrangian method, Zhang's characterisation), hidden action (the first-order approach, Propositions 22.2.1-22.2.3 and the inverse Euler equation), hidden information (Lemmas 22.3.1-22.3.3, Propositions 22.3.1-22.3.4 including concavity of the value function and immiseration), and Exercises 1-4.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 22
